headlines.title: House votes to pass short-term funding bill and prevent a shutdown before the election
headlines.description: WASHINGTON — The House voted Tuesday to pass a short-term funding bill and avert a government shutdown at the end of September, keeping money flowing at current levels until Dec. 11.

headlines.title: U.S. has launched ‘large and powerful’ strikes on Iran, Trump says
headlines.description: The U.S. has launched “large and powerful” strikes on Iranian targets near the Strait of Hormuz, President Donald Trump said Tuesday in a post on Truth Social.

headlines.title: Colin Kaepernick is done with the NFL. He isn’t done fighting.
headlines.description: Ten years after taking a knee to stand against racism and police brutality at great cost to his career and finances, Colin Kaepernick is back in the spotlight.

headlines.title: Lindsay Clancy jurors deadlocked, judge asks them to continue deliberations
headlines.description: Deliberations in the Lindsay Clancy murder trial were briefly paused this morning after the jury announced they were unable to come to a unanimous decision. NBC News' Stephanie Gosk reports on the judge's request for jurors to continue deliberations. NBC News legal analyst Misty Marris explains how and when the judge would potentially decide to move forward with a hung jury.

headlines.title: Whistleblower says USPS system Trump ordered for mail ballots is flawed and untested
headlines.description: An executive order from Trump, which is stymied in the courts, required the Postal Service to rapidly build a complex system to vet mail ballots.

headlines.title: U.S. military doesn’t plan to deploy troops to the polls in November, general says
headlines.description: Responding to a senator’s questions, Gen. Dan Caine said the Pentagon doesn’t plan to send military personnel to voting sites or to seize ballots or voting machines.

headlines.title: Times Square stabbing victim identified as Bank of America executive
headlines.description: 32-year-old Erin Piacenti from New Jersey was stabbed in the abdomen Wednesday, according to the New York Police Department. NBC News' Tom Winter provides new details on both the victim and the suspect.

headlines.title: Death Toll in Nepal Reaches Grim Milestone as it Tops 1,000
headlines.description: Nearly a week after catastrophic floods hit Nepal, the death toll there has crossed 1,000 with the dead being laid to rest in mass graves. Meanwhile, rescue teams are continuing to dig in search for thousands more missing. NBC’s Janis Mackey Frayer reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Send your questions for Richard Engel on Ukraine and more
headlines.description: Richard Engel is back in Ukraine to report on its intensifying war with Russia, with a strike this weekend on a warehouse west of Kyiv becoming its deadliest attack this year — more than 38 people were killed.

headlines.title: Kornacki Cam: Watch Steve analyze Massachusetts primary election results
headlines.description: NBC News chief data analyst Steve Kornacki breaks down real-time vote tallies from primary elections in Massachusetts, while giving viewers a behind-the-scenes look at election night coverage.

headlines.title: Man pleads guilty to breaking windows at JD Vance’s Ohio home
headlines.description: An Ohio man pleaded guilty Tuesday to charges that he vandalized Vice President JD Vance’s Cincinnati home earlier this year.
